change.description: One sentence: the single deliberate change relative to golden.

edit.description: File + rule/selector/element touched, with before/after where applicable.

goals.description: Spec §1 goals this variant exercises; empty for control/negative fixtures. 'visual' and 'technical' are allowed non-G labels.

knockOnEffects.description: Unavoidable side effects of the one deliberate change (e.g. page height delta).

urlUnderTest.description: For URL/locale-hygiene variants: the exact new-page URL to feed the tool.
